## Purpose and task

Explain the outcome and connection to Fidret's purpose. Link the issue and repository task record; for a trivial correction, capture the task here.

## Ownership and changes

Name the human owner and assisting harness. Describe the meaningful changes and any coordination with other work.

## Decisions and claims

Link durable decisions. Identify proposed choices, changed commitments, or evidence supporting new claims. State any human decision still pending.

## Verification

Record commands or review steps and results, including relevant failure cases and any checks not run.

## Handoff and review

State remaining work and request review from the other contributor when they have access. Distinguish local validation from checks actually run on GitHub.
